description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding eight {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Cryptic Trilobite
uses.cardState: with four or more +1/+1 counters on it
